summary: Statutory registration of demise required for succession, life insurance claims, and bank account settlements.

steps.title: Cremation/burial slip
steps.description: Collect cremation ground receipt or burial ground entry counterfoil signed by ground caretaker.
documents_needed: Hospital medical cause of death Form 4

steps.title: Apply online on CRS portal
steps.description: Submit deceased identity details, date, exact place of death, and applicant relation proof.

steps.title: Registrar scrutiny
steps.description: Health department officer crosses-references cremation logbook records.

steps.title: Download official death certificate
steps.description: Obtain official digitally signed Death Certificate with unique registration number.
